column1: # Compile-and-run probes of class variance of function values (#724), after Epic admitted followup-coerce's value-class-variance and followup-coerce2's value-class-result and OpenVerse began to convert any function value so (an adapter object in OpenVerse, no wrapper in Epic): through interfaces, nested function types, arrays, options, tuples and maps of function values, a bound method's value, a parametric class's instance, any and comparable as the supertype, and beside void and true results. Each header and note give OpenVerse's verdict and output (Lean and C agreeing) and what either answer changes; epic_outcome and epic_lines: - until compiled and run by UEFN 43.12 (++Fortnite+Release-43.12-CL-60598086).

column7: OpenVerse: refused, expected type{_(:dog):int}, found type{_(:any):int} (a function named there is refused too). If Epic refuses it (3502), OpenVerse agrees but for the error number. If it admits it and prints value 5, a class converts to any as it is in a function value's parameter: OpenVerse would make that conversion (its adapter discarding the argument), and likewise for a function named there.

OpenVerse: refused, expected type{_():any}, found type{_():dog} (a function named there is refused too). If Epic refuses it (3502), OpenVerse agrees but for the error number: it would cite 3502. If it admits it and prints value called, a class converts to any as it is in a function value's result: OpenVerse would make that conversion (in Verse Core an any holds no value, so its adapter discards the result), and likewise for a function named there.

OpenVerse: ran, value dogdog. If Epic admits it and prints value dogdog, OpenVerse agrees. If it refuses it (3502), containers of function values do not convert by variance: OpenVerse would refuse it (followup-coerce2's value-array-effect refuses an array whose elements need a wrapper).

OpenVerse: refused, expected type{_(:token):int}, found type{_(:comparable):int} (a function named there is refused too). If Epic refuses it (3502), OpenVerse agrees but for the error number. If it admits it and prints value 6, a unique class converts to comparable as it is in a function value's parameter: OpenVerse would make that conversion (a unique object is its own box), and likewise for a function named there.

OpenVerse: refused, expected type{_():comparable}, found type{_():token} (a function named there is refused too). If Epic refuses it (3502), OpenVerse agrees but for the error number. If it admits it and prints value different (two objects), a unique class converts to comparable as it is in a function value's result: OpenVerse would make that conversion, and likewise for a function named there.

OpenVerse: ran, value dog. If Epic admits it and prints value dog, OpenVerse agrees. If it refuses it (3502), a parametric class's instances, below by variance, need a wrapper: OpenVerse would refuse them in a value's conversion.

OpenVerse: ran, value purr. If Epic admits it and prints value purr, OpenVerse agrees. If it refuses it (3502), Epic converts by class variance but not through interfaces: OpenVerse would refuse an interface above or below in a value's conversion.
OpenVerse: ran, value purr. If Epic admits it and prints value purr, OpenVerse agrees. If it refuses it (3502), only classes, not interfaces, convert a value's result: OpenVerse would refuse it.

OpenVerse: ran, value 1dog 2dog. If Epic admits it and prints value 1dog 2dog, OpenVerse agrees. If it refuses it (3502), a map's function values do not convert by variance: OpenVerse would refuse it.

OpenVerse: ran, value 1 2 2. If Epic admits it and prints value 1 2 2 (both calls reach the one object), OpenVerse agrees; another count would mean the receiver is copied. If it refuses it (3502), a bound method's value does not convert by variance: OpenVerse would refuse it.

OpenVerse: ran, value dog. If Epic admits it and prints value dog, OpenVerse agrees. If it refuses it (3502), Epic's variance of function values stops at one level: OpenVerse would refuse a function type nested in a parameter.
OpenVerse: ran, value dog. If Epic admits it and prints value dog, OpenVerse agrees. If it refuses it (3502), a function type nested in the result needs a wrapper: OpenVerse would refuse it.
OpenVerse: ran, value dog. If Epic admits it and prints value dog, OpenVerse agrees. If it refuses it (3502), an option of a function value does not convert by variance: OpenVerse would refuse it.
OpenVerse: ran, value dog 7. If Epic admits it and prints value dog 7, OpenVerse agrees. If it refuses it (3502), a tuple's function value does not convert by variance: OpenVerse would refuse it.

OpenVerse: ran, bark dog, then value done. If Epic admits it and prints bark dog, then value done, OpenVerse agrees. If it refuses it (3502), a void result makes a value's class variance need a wrapper: OpenVerse would refuse it.

OpenVerse: ran, bark dog, then value done. If Epic admits it and prints bark dog, then value done, OpenVerse agrees. If it refuses it (3502), void and true together with class variance need a wrapper: OpenVerse would refuse it.
